article.title: Cross Sections for Electron Collisions with Molecular and Atomic Oxygen

supplement.ingestion_rule: The caller must supply an exact hash-matching workbook. Petch reads its cached OOXML values without modifying or recalculating it.

interpretation_guards: The workbook ionization product headers render minus superscripts. Article Table VII and the section context identify positive-ion production; the total positive-ionization curve is used.
Rotational excitation is omitted because the source review reports no accurate comprehensive rotational dataset.
The finite-support vibration/electronic tails and the neutral-dissociation onset are explicit sensitivity axes, not fitted parameters.
The workbook is an electron-collision input. It does not determine a reactor state, wafer flux, TiO2 surface response, or feature depth.
